text_block_list.text:
It's a yearly grand event where
Umamusume of
the classic and senior
years compete for the
time-honored
Autumn Shield.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But for the racers, the honor of winning
such a
race goes beyond simply
obtaining the trophy.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: It looks like it's about time.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
I'm off to the paddock. Why don't you
head to
the staff seating?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало
choice_data_list: I think I'll watch from the paddock.

text_block_list.text:
Okay, then make sure you stand tall and
with
purpose.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
That way you'll be easy to spot from the

paddock.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Well, I see some familiar faces.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
I mean, there aren't many races I could
call this
interesting.
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text:
The Golden Generation looks set and
ready to
go! Which one of them will win
this year's shield?
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
Whoever wins the shield will be the star
of this
generation.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Oh, please. Your intent to win has been
oozing
through that easy-going facade
of yours.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Haha, well, I guess we're all here to win,
aren't
we?
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text: Yeah, I want to beat everyone too. No—I will beat everyone!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Well then, you better not hold back. I
want to see
you both run at your best.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Show me what you two are made of!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало
